title: Tensor products over a quotient ring
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $J\subseteq R$ an ideal and $M$ an $R$-module. (1) The map $(R/J)\otimes_RM\to M/JM$, $\bar r\otimes x\mapsto rx\bmod JM$, is an isomorphism of $R$-modules. (2) For every $R/J$-module $A$ (an $R$-module via $R\to R/J$) the map $A\otimes_RM\to A\otimes_{R/J}(M/JM)$, $a\otimes x\mapsto a\otimes(x\bmod JM)$, is a well-defined isomorphism, with inverse $a\otimes\bar x\mapsto a\otimes x$; it is natural in $A$ and in $M$.
